system.description: The intricate Essence flows of the anima are as a child's toys to the savants of the Sun. This Charm allows the Solar to give up to (her Essence x 3) motes to another character. The Solar loses exactly as many motes as the target gains, in addition to the cost of this Charm, but this transfer does not count as spending motes for the purposes of anima banner flare. Transferred motes go first to the target's personal and then to the target's peripheral Essence but cannot increase either the target's personal or the target's peripheral Essence past their normal maximums.
